definition: Partial live snapshot; never overwrites final v7 report. Historical pure-FlyDSL bars are provisional, not a fresh three-way benchmark.

Previous full run. Require identical architecture/config, input metadata, global/local batch, GPU count and compiler source hashes. Another physical GPU of the same type is allowed ONLY for explicitly labeled historical preview. Current final headline eligibility remains false.
100*(Triton_ms-candidate_ms)/Triton_ms. Positive is faster; negative slower. Historical percentages are descriptive preview, not a controlled final claim.

Mixed rank0 distinct emitted training kernel names with recorded backend selection, during warmup/timing. Unknown selections explicit. Not dynamic launch counts, GPU time, ATen GEMM/conv, eager or RCCL kernels.

CURRENT cohorts compare current validated stable Triton/mix only. HISTORICAL_PREVIEW cohort includes older pure FlyDSL and must not be quoted as the final three-way result. All failed/pending/warning rows remain in model CSVs.

Models on Y, full-step runtime ms on X, three horizontal bars for Triton, FlyDSL and mixed. Default shows stable validated compatible three-arm preview. Dashboard can show training-only/partial outcomes, choose suite/GPU/tuning/axis and download filtered SVG.
Missing timing stays blank; charts label missing bars with status, never draw zero as a measurement.
